issuer: the Nova Scotia Registry of Motor Vehicles (Service Nova Scotia)
note: Service Nova Scotia's pages (read 2026-10-30): the renewal page gives a Class 5 licence for 5 years at $80.15; the examination page sets a learner's licence from 16 and a 12-month wait before the road test; the Nova Scotia Driver's Handbook says a newly licensed driver stays at least two full years at that stage, then two full years in the restricted individual stage, before the full Class 5 licence, so the full licence is kept from 21. No identification card page was found on the registry's site, so none is held.

Service Nova Scotia, Driver's licence examination
sources.said: In order to obtain a Learner's licence, you must be a minimum of 16 years old ... If you have a Learner's Licence, you must wait 12 months from the date your Learner's licence was issued before applying for a road test.

sources.title: Nova Scotia Driver's Handbook
sources.said: You remain in this stage for at least two full years. ... You will remain in this stage for 2 full years. ... To complete the graduated licence program and receive your full Class 5 or Class 6 licence
